requirement.description: The View class has incomplete implementation for handling layout validation and error reporting. Several tests fail due to incorrect error messages and missing validation for layout conflicts.
requirement.contract: When a View is created with a layout that conflicts with class attributes, it should properly warn about shadowed attributes. When accessing fields via getattr, it should provide meaningful error messages with suggestions for similar field names.

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method doesn't correctly handle array layout indexing with dynamic values and has incorrect error messages for missing keys in struct layouts.
requirement.contract: When indexing a View with array layout, it should accept Value-castable objects as indices and provide appropriate error messages. When indexing a View with struct layout using a missing key, it should raise KeyError with the correct key.

requirement.description: The Layout._convert_to_int method has issues with handling different initialization types for complex layouts.
requirement.contract: When converting layout constants to integers, it should properly handle mappings, sequences, and scalar values with appropriate error messages.

requirement.description: The Signal.__init__ method doesn't properly handle reset values for ShapeCastable types that don't have a const method or when the reset value is incompatible with the shape.
requirement.contract: When initializing a Signal with a ShapeCastable shape and reset value, it should validate that the reset value is compatible with the shape. If not, it should raise a TypeError with an appropriate error message.

requirement.description: The StructLayout class implementation has issues with handling complex layouts and inheritance patterns, particularly with nested structs and base class methods.
requirement.contract: When constructing Struct layouts with inheritance, it should properly handle base class methods and properties. The layout should support nested struct definitions and proper field access.
